info.name: ChoreStrike
info.summary: Gamified household task management - keep your home clean together!
info.description:
ChoreStrike turns household chores into a fun, cooperative game.
**Features:** - 🏠 Organize tasks by rooms and floors - 📅 Smart scheduling with flexible planning options - 🎮 Gamification: Coins, combos, streaks and medals - 👥 Multi-user support with leaderboards - 🏆 Weekly medals and household goals - 🔥 Streak protection so you never lose progress on a busy day - 🌍 Multilingual (German, English, more to come) - 📊 Track progress with House Health and room cleanliness
Complete tasks, build streaks and keep your home tidy together. Perfect for families and roommates!
info.author: ChoreStrike Contributors
